title: Pigeon permits.
bodyText: The department shall issue a pigeon ownership permit to any person who raises pigeons and shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to effectuate this part.
bodyHtml: [§142-102]  Pigeon permits.  The department shall issue a pigeon ownership permit to any person who raises pigeons and shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to effectuate this part. [L 1989, c 9, pt of §2]
